description: VR mod for New Super Lucky's Tale (Steam): play it in a SteamVR headset with motion controllers.
notes: NSLT-VR is installed into your New Super Lucky's Tale folder (found through Steam).
Play with the 'New Super Lucky's Tale VR' shortcut on your desktop / Start menu.
Optional: 'NSLT-VR - Add to Steam' in the Start menu adds it to your Steam and SteamVR libraries with artwork (closes and restarts Steam).
Game in an unusual place? Set the NSLTVR_GAMEDIR environment variable to its folder and install again.

script: Set-Content "$dir\Add to Steam.bat" -Encoding ASCII -Value @('@echo off', 'powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0add-steam-vr-shortcut.ps1"', 'pause')
# On update the new version's installer simply installs over the old one; only a real uninstall removes the mod.
